description: This file defines the Request class within the Nyholm\Psr7 namespace, implementing the RequestInterface for HTTP request handling. It provides a constructor to initialize HTTP request objects with method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version, and includes traits for message and request behaviors.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implements an HTTP request message with method, URI, headers, and body features, conforming to PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTP request object with specified method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version, setting default headers and URI attributes as needed.
